name: go-ansible-isolated-multi-playbook-runs
instr:
Add ordered run sets so callers can execute independently configured playbook members without combining them into one process. Preserve each member's identity across command construction, execution, output, outcomes, and measurement. Existing execution paths must remain unchanged when run sets are not used.

`NewRunSet`, `RunSet.Append`, and `RunSet.Commands` preserve insertion order, snapshot caller-owned inputs, assign unique nonempty identities, and produce one isolated command per member; `RunSet.Append` rejects a duplicate explicit identity at append time. `RunSet.Validate` reports every invalid member through `ValidationError` before any process starts. `NewRunSetExecutor` and `RunSetExecutor.Execute` request one context-bound process per validated member. From `github.com/apenella/go-ansible/v2/pkg/execute`, `OutputObserver` and `WithOutputObserver` deliver every `MemberOutput` with its member and stream identity while each callback independently preserves its established parsing, byte, line, verbosity, and quiet behavior. Cancellation and `RunPolicy` stop future starts while preserving ordered terminal state for every started member; cancellation during an active member is recorded in that member's terminal outcome and returned to the run-set caller without losing completed outcomes. `RunReport.Outcomes` and `RunReport.Durations` expose one ordered outcome and duration per started member, while `RunReport` exposes a `TotalDuration` covering the delegated invocation. C
